page.layout: One page of text, single column; ornamental woodcut headpiece at the top; a signature mark "ij" with a pilcrow-like sign at the foot. No margin notes.

main_text.head: FIDELI SERVO DEI, D. CHRISTIANO AD PORTVM, S. Theologiæ in Ecclesia Bernensi Doctori, fratri obseruando Th. Beza gratiam & pacem à Domino.

p.i: VT quidem in eo recte omnino facis, obseruande frater, & quod hominem nomine & re Christianū decet, quòd veritatem in vicinia vestra tam insoleter impugnatam propugnas. sed illud sanè nimiū timidè, quòd per te non stetit quominus hoc vtilissimo labore tuo penè solus frueris. Ego verò contra fortassis audaculus, & quidem in alieno,

page.notes: The initial "V" of the first word is a large woodcut historiated initial "T" ("Vt" begins the paragraph; the woodcut letter is T, so the word reads "Vt"). Doubtful: the first word is printed with a large decorated initial; read as "VT". The signature at the foot reads "¶ iij" (printed as a pilcrow with "iij"). No page number or running head is printed.
